summary:
What we developed:
A website concept created to help researchers upload, interpret, and visualize complex radar satellite observations (specifically NASA-ISRO NISAR data files) with clear AI assistance.


How it addresses the challenge:
NISAR data files hold complex scientific data that typically require specialist knowledge and manual tools to interpret and visualize. EarthPulse AI bridges this gap by automatically translating complex raw files into simple, easy-to-understand explanations and visual graphics.


Why it is important:
It lowers the barrier to entry for accessing and understanding vital Earth observation data, enabling researchers and scientists to process measurements more efficiently without needing deep specialist expertise in radar data processing
details:
EarthPulse Ai

what does it do? It takes the satellite imagery and data from the NISAR satellite and process the complicated data into simple, easy to understand explanations and graphs

How does it work? we process the information through an advance AI model, which simplifies the data and helps the user understand the given data in proper explanations and graphs

what is the intended impact of the project? To make understanding NISAR data more easier and convenient

We used a website builder, it is called bolt.new , we also used ASF Data Search Vertex to obtain mappings and data For processing, we used an ai model to process the mappings and data

How is your project creative? it in itself is built for people to understand the data, for them to use it in their own creative projects!

When we started the hackathon and looked at the resources, we originally thought that it was going to be possible but it was very very hard to understand and hard to find ways to implement, we built this as a tool that in Itself is something we would use to help ourselves understand what the data says
